description: This file implements the SensorsHandler class for managing sensor data collection, subscription, and communication with clients in a WebRTC streaming context within the cuttlefish project.

classes.name: SensorsHandler
classes.description: Manages sensor data updates, client subscriptions, and communication with sensor hardware.

methods.name: SensorsHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sensor handler with a file descriptor.

methods.name: RefreshSensors
methods.description: Updates sensor readings with new x, y, z values.

methods.name: GetSensorsData
methods.description: Retrieves current sensor data as a string.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming sensor messages and updates UI.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new client subscription for sensor updates.

methods.name: UpdateSensorsUi
methods.description: Fetches latest sensor data and sends updates to all clients.
